answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each reputation slot to stake a bonded deposit verified against a shared kernel of prior work history. New agents start on a probationary mesa, earning trust only through sustained, peer-attested contributions. Each epoch, the protocol samples a willow of randomly chosen validators to challenge identities; a sybil cluster must fund and defend many deposits simultaneously, making forgery costlier than honest participation.
